ref: Diagnose possible threatened miscarriage in antenatal patient
text: Page says 'likely' (-> probable by house rule) and only in early pregnancy < 22 weeks; rule is possible and has no gestation limit, so a late-pregnancy bleed with no os findings recorded yields possible threatened miscarriage.

ref: Diagnose possible complete miscarriage in antenatal patient
text: Same as threatened miscarriage: certainty downgraded from 'likely' and no < 22 weeks constraint.

ref: Diagnose possible ectopic pregnancy in antenatal patient with vaginal bleeding
text: 'Refer to exclude ectopic pregnancy' -> possible is correct, but without the < 22 weeks constraint it fires in late pregnancy too.

ref: Diagnose possible incomplete miscarriage in antenatal patient
